svg.text: Mesh LOD — camera sets the ceiling, road content sets the floor
301 chunks of 32 m, 274k vertices against 5.76 M for a uniform 0.25 m mesh. Camera (white ring) stands on the main road.
Grass-vs-mesh disagreement, sampled only where grass may stand: p99 stays under 0.3 px at every distance; cracks across LOD boundaries measure 0.00000255 m.
Interior L0 patches are road corridors held fine regardless of distance — that is the tiling's classification reused as the LOD floor.
